visualCharacteristics.purpose: Boxed KPI slider with vertical icon navigation and large stat figures
visualCharacteristics.description: Very light grey-blue band (rgb 243,246,251) containing a white card; left vertical icon nav (5 KPI icons), prev/next arrows; slide title blue uppercase, stats as large blue numbers with label and delta. Right-aligned "PER SAPERNE DI PIÙ >" link below.

contentPattern.summary: Boxed slider with vertical icon navigation and stat figures (large numbers + labels) instead of photos.
contentPattern.structure: one row per slide. Cell 1: category icon (used as the nav button). Cell 2: title (heading), reference date paragraph, then stats: each paragraph starting with a number starts a stat, followed by its label and delta (+/-, "vs") paragraphs; alternatively a list with one item per stat, or one extra cell per stat
contentPattern.sourceContent: 5 slides (Economico Finanziari, Operativi, Sociali, Ambientali, Governance): icon, title, reference date, 3-4 stat values with labels

usage: Homepage KPI highlights (economic-financial, operational, social, environmental, governance).
reuseGuidance: Use for number-driven slides. For photo slides use carousel-hero.
